scripts.package: npm run build && artifact_version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && mkdir -p "output/v$artifact_version" && zip -j "output/v$artifact_version/lambda.zip" dist/index.js
scripts.deploy: npm run validate && npm run package && artifact_version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && artifact_bucket=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-sso-local-profile}" --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" --stack-name agentic-setup-s3 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ArtifactBucketName'].OutputValue" --output text) && object_version=$(aws s3api put-object --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-sso-local-profile}" --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" --bucket "$artifact_bucket" --key "v$artifact_version/lambda.zip" --body "output/v$artifact_version/lambda.zip" --query VersionId --output text) && aws cloudformation deploy --profile "${AWS_PROFILE:-sso-local-profile}" --region "${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}" --stack-name agentic-setup-lambda --template-file cloudformation/agentic-setup-lambda.yaml --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --parameter-overrides CodeBucket="$artifact_bucket" CodeKey="v$artifact_version/lambda.zip" CodeVersion="$object_version"
